physical: In an ideal gas the average translational kinetic energy per molecule is three halves of k times the temperature: temperature measures mean molecular kinetic energy.
reflected_sentence: Movement M times the square of rise per Expansion equals a fixed constant times the thermal intensity, and this identity keeps its shape.
rule_reason: Identity (form is identity with no costs), which keeps its shape, but Boltzmann constant and temperature have no partners in the frozen vocabulary.
interpretation: Identities keep their shape, and numbers do not cross the Point of Reflection. Mass m reflects as Movement M and velocity reflects as rise per Expansion, while temperature and the Boltzmann constant have no partners in the frozen vocabulary.
closing: The rule decided on its own that an identity with no costs keeps its shape and that numerical factors (1/2, 3/2) drop out. While the left-hand side maps mass m to Movement M and velocity to rise per Expansion, the right-hand side is completely unmapped because k and T are not in the frozen vocabulary.
